# Alexandra Studio

> Alexandra Studio is a Stockholm B2B growth studio that works only with fintech companies. It gets the buyers a fintech can't reach on its own into a room the fintech co-hosts with a brand those buyers already trust: executive breakfasts, dinners, panels, builder nights and build days. The client names the target accounts; Alexandra Studio designs the room, brings the co-host, runs the invitations and reports who came, by name. Founded and led by Alexandra Grisanti.

Key facts:

- Founder: Alexandra Grisanti. American, moved to Sweden in 2021, lives on Södermalm in Stockholm. Master of Architecture (landscape architecture). Career since 2022: UX researcher and lead B2B white-label product designer at Zwapgrid, service designer at Monitum, then ad designer at the Stockholm agency Heijbel Growth.
- Also runs the Operator Network (a curated community and stage for founders and executives in Stockholm) and publishes the Stockholm Growth & Fintech newsletter. These are not separate firms; clients contract with Alexandra Studio only.
- Founder-led: Alexandra personally leads every engagement. Production support is contracted per event. One client per vertical at a time.
- Registered business: Alexandra Studio is the trading name of A. Grisanti Ventures, VAT SE930825284101, approved for F-skatt.
- 2026 track record: eleven in-person B2B events in Stockholm and Amsterdam for Heijbel Growth, Solvapay and Cardboard, including the Embedded Finance Build Day on 25 August 2026 (SEK 25,000 spent, 26 companies, 44 builders, 14 warm leads at SEK 1,785 each, no paid ads). Hosted the Nordic Fintech Highlights Stage at Nordic Fintech Summit 2026 in Helsinki. Panelist at Stockholm Fintech Week 2026.
- Pipeline figures (such as ~SEK 1.5M for the Build Day) are estimates based on an assumed ~20% conversion rate, not booked revenue. Counted results and estimates are reported separately.
- Pricing: eight-week growth engagement at SEK 45,000 per month, with a guarantee (if 30 qualified leads and 5 held calls are not reached by week eight, the invoice for weeks five to eight is cancelled). Single projects have a fixed fee plus costs billed at cost.
- Newsletter readership (22 October 2026): 1,215 subscribers, 94% on work email addresses, 193 readers at 53 banks including 29 at Nordea.
- Contact: alexandra@alexandrastudio.se
